# PCDeck

> PCDeck turns an Android phone into a wireless trackpad, keyboard, emergency
> second display, audio receiver and file-transfer endpoint for a Windows PC. It runs
> entirely over your local Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot with no cloud account, no telemetry
> and no internet connection required.

PCDeck is an independent Windows + Android utility. It is distributed directly
from this site rather than through the Microsoft Store or Google Play, so the
installer is unsigned and both operating systems will show a reputation warning the first
time you run it. That is expected for independent software and is explained in
detail under "Installation warnings" below.

## What it actually does

- **Wireless trackpad and keyboard.** Multi-touch gestures, scrolling, click and
  drag, plus a full on-screen keyboard with numpad. Useful when a mouse or
  keyboard has failed.
- **Emergency display for a PC with a broken screen.** The desktop is streamed to
  the phone, so a machine with a dead or cracked monitor stays usable: you can
  see the screen and drive it from the phone. This is the single most common
  reason people install PCDeck.
- **Desktop screen streaming.** Live view of the Windows desktop on the phone at
  up to 60/120 FPS depending on the selected quality and network conditions.
- **Live PC audio to the phone.** Windows output audio is streamed to the phone
  so wired or Bluetooth phone headphones can be used as PC headphones.
- **Bidirectional file transfer.** A two-pane file browser moves files between
  phone and PC over Wi-Fi without a USB cable, using resumable HTTP range
  requests so an interrupted transfer continues instead of restarting.
- **Reverse phone mirroring.** The Android screen can also be shown and
  controlled on the PC (built on scrcpy over ADB).

## Platform requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit).
- Android 5.0 or newer.
- Both devices on the same Wi-Fi network, or the PC connected to the phone's
  hotspot. No internet access is needed after download.
- No Python, .NET or driver install: the PC side is a single self-contained
  executable.

## Pricing

Core use is free. A one-time $3.99 lifetime licence unlocks the higher
performance tier (60/120 FPS streaming and faster transfers). There is no
subscription and no recurring charge.

## Privacy

PCDeck is offline by design. All traffic stays on the local network between the
phone and the PC. There is no account, no cloud relay, no analytics and no
telemetry. Because nothing is proxied through a third-party server, screen
content and transferred files never leave the local network.

## Installation warnings (the most frequently asked question)

PCDeck is not published through the Microsoft Store or Google Play, so it does not
carry an enterprise EV certificate. Both platforms warn about direct downloads
regardless of what they contain. Nothing is wrong with the download.

**Windows - "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen):**
This dialog appears because the executable is new and unsigned, not because
a threat was detected. To proceed: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
SmartScreen reputation is earned by download volume over time.

**Windows Defender / antivirus flags:**
An unsigned executable that captures the screen, synthesises mouse and keyboard
input and opens a local network port matches the generic behavioural profile of
remote-access tooling, so heuristic engines sometimes flag it as a false positive.
Those are exactly the capabilities a wireless trackpad needs in order to work.
If a scanner flags it, verify the SHA-256 hash first before whitelisting.

**Android - "Install blocked" / unknown sources:**
Sideloading an APK requires granting install permission once: open the APK, then
allow **Install unknown apps** for the browser or file manager you used. Play
Protect may additionally say the app was not scanned before; choosing
**Install anyway** proceeds.

**How to verify the download independently:**
Compare the SHA-256 checksum published on the download page with the file you
received, and optionally upload the file to VirusTotal.

## Feature Pages & Landing Guides

- **How to use an Android phone as a mouse for PC** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-phone-as-mouse/
  Turns your phone into a low-latency multi-touch trackpad over local Wi-Fi. Supports
  tap to click, two-finger scrolling, right-click, double-tap drag, and middle click.

- **How to use an Android phone as a keyboard for PC** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-phone-as-keyboard/
  Full virtual QWERTY keyboard, dedicated numeric keypad (numpad), Windows modifier chords
  (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win key), function row (F1-F12), and mobile voice dictation to Windows.

- **How to use an Android phone as a screen for PC** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-phone-as-second-monitor/
  Real-time Windows desktop streaming to Android over local Wi-Fi with direct touch-to-click
  interaction. Ideal for emergency screen recovery, broken laptop displays, and headless PCs.

- **How to control a Windows PC from Android** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/control-windows-from-android/
  Comprehensive guide to unified PC control from Android: wireless mouse, keyboard, live screen,
  PC audio streaming, and high-speed local file manager in one connection.

## Problem-Solving Emergency Guides

- **How to use a PC without a mouse** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-pc-without-mouse/
  Keyboard-only control of Windows: Tab/Shift+Tab and arrow keys to move focus,
  Enter and Space to act, F6 to cycle window regions; Win then type then Enter to
  launch anything; Alt+Tab, Win+Tab, Win+D, Win+E, Win+R, Win+X, Win+I, Alt+F4,
  Ctrl+Shift+Esc. **Shift+F10, or the dedicated Menu key, replaces right-click.**
  File Explorer with no pointer: type-ahead selection, F2, Ctrl+A, Shift+arrows,
  Ctrl+C/X/V instead of dragging, Alt+Up, Alt+Left, Ctrl+L. Then **Mouse Keys** (Left Alt + Left Shift + Num Lock).

- **How to use a PC without a keyboard** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-pc-without-keyboard/
  Sign-in screen accessibility On-Screen Keyboard, Win+Ctrl+O inside Windows, voice typing
  (Win+H), symbol panel (Win+.), and virtual phone keyboard alternatives.

- **How to use a PC without a monitor** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-pc-without-monitor/
  Emergency troubleshooting when a laptop display or monitor is black/cracked:
  Win+P to cycle projection, Win+Ctrl+Shift+B to restart graphics drivers,
  Win+Ctrl+Enter for Narrator blind audio cues, and streaming the desktop live to
  an Android phone over Wi-Fi using PCDeck.

- **How to stream PC audio to phone headphones** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/stream-pc-audio-to-phone/
  Wirelessly route Windows PC audio to phone headphones over local Wi-Fi with low
  latency 48 kHz stereo streaming. Solves broken headphone jacks and missing desktop Bluetooth.

- **How to transfer files between PC and Android without cable** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/transfer-files-pc-to-android/
  Offline high-speed two-way file sharing over local Wi-Fi with auto-resume. No USB
  cable MTP disconnects, no Bluetooth slowness, and no cloud upload bandwidth limits.

- **How to control a Windows PC without internet** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/use-pc-without-internet/
  Step-by-step instructions for remote-controlling Windows from an Android phone
  over offline local Wi-Fi or phone mobile hotspot with zero internet access or router.

- **Security & Privacy Architecture** — https://pcdeck.vercel.app/security/
  Detailed technical teardown of local network isolation, direct socket binding,
  zero telemetry data minimization, and independent SHA-256 binary verification.

## Comparison with alternatives

Compared with Remote Mouse, Unified Remote and similar remote-control apps,
PCDeck (also written "PC Deck") works fully offline with no account, acts as
an emergency display for a PC whose monitor has failed, streams PC audio to
the phone, and includes resumable high-speed file transfer. The core app is free;
Pro is an optional one-time in-app unlock for 60/120 FPS streaming.
